notes.title: Monospaced Lovers Lunar New Year Sale - Lowest Price Ever
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Monospaced Lovers[/i] will be featured in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. We'd like to extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian fan community.

During the event period, [i]Monospaced Lovers[/i] will be available at its lowest price ever with a [b]-20%[/b] discount, now only [b]15.99 USD[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164460/_/

[i]Monospaced Lovers[/i] is an exploration-driven platformer about closeness and distance.
Journey through a metafictional, fantasy-filled land and find the truth of your fragile world before it disintegrates.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

notes.title: Monospaced Lovers Demo v2.0 — Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36710203/3f34615248b90c16d42d5f7ac95786759f2748a3.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that [b]our demo v2.0 is finally ready for release[/b]! The update is live, so you can try it today.

The content of this demo is roughly the same as the 1.0 release, but it includes our all-new environment art, revamped platforming physics, custom-made sound effects, and more. As a whole, this release should feel a lot more polished than our previous demos.

As always, feedback is very much appreciated! Feel free to [url=discord.gg/n6GQhXy]chat with us on Discord[/url]. You can also use the in-game feedback form to send us an anonymous message.

Finally, if you're interested in playing more of the game, we're currently accepting playtester signups! Join our Discord (linked above) for details.

And don't forget to add Monospaced Lovers to your wishlist if you haven't already!

Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164460/Monospaced_Lovers/

notes.title: Monospaced Lovers Chapter 1 Livestream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36710203/98c633c4dc3599f1747cd84a7e32d3987d5b2e06.gif[/img]

[h2]Ch1 Demo w/ Dev Commentary[/h2]
As part of the Steam Game Festival, we're happy to present a [b]live streaming event[/b] featuring the first chapter of Monospaced Lovers! The lead dev (that's me) will play through the full demo while providing commentary along the way.

The game contains a lot of text, and I'll try to approach the demo as if I'm a first-time player (while trying to ignore the fact that I've speedran it a hundred times). As a result, the stream could last more than an hour, but don't feel bad if you have to leave early.

Will the commentary be useful, or funny, or otherwise interesting? Will the stream run from start to finish without any technical difficulties? The answer to these questions — and more — will be revealed soon. Tune in to find out!

notes.title: Monospaced Lovers Demo Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36710203/9b5450a017b00160731758a08071b726f899dc9a.gif[/img]


Monospaced Lovers is a story-rich platformer filled with wonder and mystery. When Clara wakes up to a phone that isn't hers, she must journey through a strange but comfy world to find out who the Gòd o͏f̴ B̴in͠a̸r̨y̧ really is — and why her new friend woke up to a phone that wasn't his. 

We hope to capture a sense of adventure inspired by games like [i]FEZ[/i] and [i]La-Mulana[/i], while delivering a whimsical yet emotional narrative inspired by [i]To the Moon[/i], [i]Undertale[/i], and much more.

The entirety of Chapter 1 is free to play, and it takes 1-2 hrs to complete.

We're still in the process of collecting feedback and improving the game, so we appreciate everyone who takes the time to try out the demo! In particular, we're planning to improve the environment art and create more assets to really bring the game's world to life. If you have feedback but you'd rather not comment publicly, [url=http://freesuggestionbox.com/pub/iwhyiqn]please consider leaving anonymous feedback in our suggestion box[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36710203/98c633c4dc3599f1747cd84a7e32d3987d5b2e06.gif[/img]


Enjoy!
